title: Result: Ok and Err
tips: Use `Result` when the failure reason matters — `Option` only says 'missing'
`Ok` and `Err` are just enum variants — all enum operations work on Result
Name the error type meaningfully: `Result[Int, Str]` for messages, `Result[Int, Int]` for codes
Check both `Ok` and `Err` — the compiler enforces exhaustive matching
